settings.pantry: salt, pepper, olive oil, butter, garlic clove

recipes.name: Pasta al limone
steps: Boil the pasta in well salted water for 9 minutes.
Grate the lemon zest and squeeze the juice.
Melt the butter with the garlic over low heat, 2 minutes.
Toss the pasta with butter, zest, juice, parmesan and a splash of pasta water until glossy.
Tear over the basil and serve.

recipes.name: Oven salmon with potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C.
Halve the potatoes and roast with oil and salt for 25 minutes.
Lay the salmon on top for the last 15 minutes.
Stir dill, lemon and red onion into the crème fraîche.
Serve with the sauce.

recipes.name: Red lentil stew
steps: Fry the onion and garlic until soft, 5 minutes.
Add the curry powder and fry for 1 minute.
Add lentils, tomatoes, coconut milk and 3 dl water. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts.
Season with salt and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.name: Meatballs with mash
steps: Soak the breadcrumbs in 1 dl water for 5 minutes.
Mix with the mince, egg, salt and pepper. Roll into small balls.
Boil the potatoes for 20 minutes.
Fry the meatballs in butter, 8 minutes, turning them.
Mash the potatoes with milk and butter. Serve with lingonberries.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
steps: Fry the onion and pepper for 8 minutes.
Add cumin and tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Make four hollows and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook for 6 minutes.
Crumble over the feta. Serve with bread.

recipes.name: Halloumi tacos
steps: Slice the halloumi and fry until golden, 3 minutes a side.
Shred the cabbage and toss with lime juice and salt.
Mash the avocado.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with everything and top with yoghurt and coriander.

recipes.name: Chicken and coconut curry
steps: Start the rice.
Fry the curry paste for 1 minute.
Add the chicken in pieces and brown, 5 minutes.
Add coconut milk and pepper. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Finish with lime juice.

recipes.name: Potato and leek soup
steps: Slice the leeks and soften in butter, 8 minutes.
Add potatoes in pieces and the stock.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Blend smooth and stir in the cream.
Serve with bread.
